text:
Marta (partnerships): NovaHW reported several customers showing 0 credits during 22:00-23:00 UTC on 2026-03-17. They attached sample webhook ids.
WebhookBot: alert: webhook_delivery_latency: partner=novahw region=eu avg_latency=350s failures=3
Ethan (eng-partnerships): I pulled delivery logs. We see a pattern: partner event_ts are 2-3s ahead of our receive_ts consistently -> clock skew causing dedupe mismatch when we canonicalize event IDs (ms vs us). Some retries arrived 6-8m later.
Lena (billing): Immediate risk: if we accept replayed events without metadata, customers may be double-billed or invoices mis-stated. We need a replay_id and a billing flag on any backfill.
Kai (infra): Two quick mitigations: (A) normalize event_id by rounding timestamps to the nearest second before dedupe, (B) log raw_event_ts into audit stream so reconciler can resolve microsecond differences. Both low-risk.
Marta (partnerships): NovaHW prefers minimal changes. They requested we don't change retry behavior on their side. Can we do server-side tolerant dedupe + targeted replay?
Ethan (eng-partnerships): Yes. Plan: 1) implement "tolerant-dedupe" that drops sub-second differences when comparing event ids (feature-flagged per partner), 2) add replay metadata labels: billing.replay=true, billing.replay_id=<uuid>, ingest_path=marketplace, 3) run a targeted replay using provided event ids.
WebhookBot: action: replay_job created id=rj-20260317-07 by ethan
Kai (infra): Reconciler design snippet:
```
reconciler:
  partner: novahw
  max_lag: 48h
  idempotency_key: normalized_event_id
  attach_audit: true
  emit_metrics: reconciler.novahw.processed, reconciler.novahw.skipped
```
Lena (billing): Billing checklist for this replay:
- All replayed events must have billing.replay_id.
- Mark invoices intersecting replayed hours as provisional until reconciliation completes.
- Notify customers with adjustments > $2 and include reconciliation_report.csv.
Marta (partnerships): Communication draft to NovaHW: short summary + ask for sign-off on targeted replay of 12 event ids. ETA for partner OK?
NovaHW (external): ok to proceed, keep us updated. prefer replay_id in header.
Ethan (eng-partnerships): I'll open PR: tolerant-dedupe flag + normalization function + replay metadata injection. Test plan: unit tests for normalization, end-to-end staging replay, invoice snapshot test.
Kai (infra): I'll add a small probe that samples partner timestamps from incoming events and reports clock_skew.p50/p95 to metrics. If p95 > 1s trigger warning.
Lena (billing): Also please set a ledger tag ledger.source=backfill for all replayed rows so downstream ETL can filter for accounting.
Marta (partnerships): Owners & ETA:
- Ethan: PR + staging replay harness (ETA: 5h)
- Kai: probe + reconcile worker config (ETA: 8h)
- Lena: billing hold + notification template (ETA: EOD)
- Marta: partner communication + sign-off (ETA: 2h)
Ethan (eng-partnerships): Staging replay command:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/internal/replay \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STG_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"partner":"novahw","events":["c1d2e3","c1d2e4"],"dry_run":true}'
```
WebhookBot: job_update: rj-20260317-07 dry_run completed, discrepancies=1
Ethan (eng-partnerships): Dry run found one event with timestamp older than allowed window (>24h). Marked for manual review and excluded from auto-replay.
Marta (partnerships): Good catch. I'll ask NovaHW if they retried an old backlog. If they confirm, we'll do manual ingestion for that event.
Lena (billing): One more ask: include replay_id in customer-facing reconciliation_report. That way finance can tie adjustments to a single backfill.
Marta (partnerships): Agreed. I'll post the final replay_id here when queued. Everyone ok to proceed after partner confirms?
Ethan (eng-partnerships): No objections. Flagging PR when ready.
Kai (infra): Adding clock_skew probe to infra config now.
Marta (partnerships): thanks team. I'll update within 2h. :pray:
